title: dimocarpus fumatus subsp. javensis
intro: Dimocarpus fumatus subsp. javensis, commonly known as Java plum, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia, specifically in Indonesia and Malaysia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, diarrhea, and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Java plum include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-bacterial properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Java plum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
